events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect walkthroughs worktree state and disk
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-walkthroughs && git log --oneline -3 && git status --short | head -80 && git status --short | wc -l && df -h . && cat .gitignore | tail -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check commit contents, push state, ignore rules
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-walkthroughs && git show --stat 2e9db5c | tail -15; git show --stat HEAD~1 HEAD~2 | grep -c "|" ; git status -sb | head -1; git log origin/tantra-walkthroughs..HEAD --oneline | wc -l; git check-ignore -v scripts/walkthroughs/node_modules scripts/walkthroughs/frames 2>&1 | head; ls scripts/walkthroughs | head -50; wc -c app/public/walkthrough-review.html

events.name: Bash
events.head: Secret scan and ignore check
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-walkthroughs && cat scripts/walkthroughs/.gitignore; grep -nEo "sk_[A-Za-z0-9]{6,}|re_[A-Za-z0-9]{10,}|Bearer [A-Za-z0-9]|[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[a-z]{2,}|token=[^\"& ]+" app/public/walkthrough-review.html | sort -u | head; git grep -nE "sk_(live|test)_[A-Za-z0-9]{8,}|Bearer [A-Za-z0-9]{12,}|re_[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}" -- scripts/walkthroughs | head; git ls-files scripts/walkthroughs | grep -E "\.(mp4|png|jpg)$" | head; du -sh scripts/walkthroughs/captures 2>/dev/null; git check-ignore -v scripts/walkthroughs/captures/x.mp4 scripts/walkthroughs/recordings/z

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect review page and find 4K masters
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-walkthroughs && head -c 1500 app/public/walkthrough-review.html; echo; grep -oE "(src|href)=\"[^\"]+\"" app/public/walkthrough-review.html | sort -u | head -20; find . -name "*.mp4" -size +20M -not -path "./node_modules/*" 2>/dev/null | head; grep -n "4K\|wt-review\|mp4" .gitignore

events.text: Pipeline is already committed and pushed (2e9db5c). No T-282 approvals yet, so next is preparing the 1440p web copies while every tool stays held. Checking what exists.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect existing video assets and walkthroughs.ts
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-walkthroughs && ls -la app/public/wt-review/zoom app/public/walkthroughs/zoom 2>&1; ls app/public/walkthroughs | head -30; grep -n "HELD_FOR_REVIEW\|poster\|captions\|vtt\|src:" app/src/lib/walkthroughs.ts | head -40; git log --oneline -1 main; git -C /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign log --oneline -1 main

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read finalize/render scripts and data shape
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-walkthroughs && cat scripts/walkthroughs/finalize.sh; cat scripts/walkthroughs/render.sh; head -c 600 scripts/walkthroughs/recordings/zoom/timeline.json; echo; head -3 scripts/walkthroughs/recordings/zoom/steps.jsonl; git merge-base --is-ancestor main HEAD && echo branch-contains-main || git rev-list --count HEAD..main

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check caption format and composition timing
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-walkthroughs/scripts/walkthroughs && head -12 ../../app/public/walkthroughs/zoom/captions.vtt; ls motion motion/src; grep -rnE "INTRO|OUTRO|fps|durationInFrames|secs" motion/src/*.tsx | head -30; which ffmpeg ffprobe

events.name: Bash
events.head: Test web copy export on zoom
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-walkthroughs/scripts/walkthroughs && time python3 webcopy.py zoom && ls -la ../../app/public/wt-review/zoom/web && head -8 ../../app/public/wt-review/zoom/web/captions.vtt

events.text: 24.7 MB is right at the Workers 25 MiB asset limit, so I'm raising CRF to get the files well under it.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Re-export at CRF 28 and grab a still
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-walkthroughs/scripts/walkthroughs && sed -i '' 's/"-crf", "22"/"-crf", "28", "-tune", "stillimage"/' webcopy.py && python3 webcopy.py zoom && cd ../../app/public/wt-review/zoom/web && ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -ss 40 -i zoom.mp4 -frames:v 1 /tmp/zoom-web-40.jpg && echo ok

events.text: The 1440p frame is sharp and readable at 15.6 MB. Now exporting the other 17 tools.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Export web copies for the remaining 17 tools
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-walkthroughs/scripts/walkthroughs && python3 webcopy.py $(ls ../../app/public/wt-review | grep -v -e index.html -e zoom) 2>&1 | tee /tmp/t284-webcopy.log

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read main's walkthroughs.ts structure
events.input: $ grep -n "HELD_FOR_REVIEW" -A12 app/src/lib/walkthroughs.ts | head -30; grep -nE "^\s+tool: " app/src/lib/walkthroughs.ts; sed -n 1,40p app/src/lib/walkthroughs.ts

events.name: Bash
events.head: Add staged meta.json output to webcopy.py

events.name: Bash
events.head: Wait for exports to finish
events.input: $ for i in $(seq 1 55); do [ $(grep -c "MB ->" /tmp/t284-webcopy.log) -ge 17 ] && break; grep -q -i "error\|mismatch\|Traceback" /tmp/t284-webcopy.log && break; sleep 10; done; cat /tmp/t284-webcopy.log
